paper_title: Searching for Dark Matter with a Superconducting Qubit
notes: Dixit et al. (arXiv:2008.12231) hidden photon dark matter search using a superconducting transmon qubit as a QND single-photon counter coupled to a 6.011 GHz (24.86 ueV) storage cavity. Excludes kinetic mixing epsilon > 1.68e-15 at 90% CL on resonance, assuming rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3. The limit is a very narrow band: sensitivity falls to -3 dB at ~3 kHz detuning from cavity resonance (QDM ~ 1e6 lineshape), with additional weaker sidebands at odd multiples of 2chi (~6.000-6.022 GHz shown in figure inset), but only the on-resonance numerical value is stated explicitly in the text, so a single data point is provided. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 1))
